shellCommands.command: rm /workspace/components/AppProvider.js && rm -rf /workspace/pages && ls /workspace && find /workspace/app -type f | sort

cd /workspace && (npm run start -- -p 3100 >/tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 6 && echo "--- home (UA echo + SSR)" && curl -s -A "SmokeTestUA/1.0" http://localhost:3100/ | grep -o "SmokeTestUA/1.0" && curl -s http://localhost:3100/ | grep -o "Server-side rendered at: [^<]*" | head -1 && echo "--- home meta" && curl -s http://localhost:3100/ | grep -o "<title>[^<]*</title>" && echo "--- blog meta" && curl -s http://localhost:3100/blog | grep -o "<title>[^<]*</title>" && echo "--- post meta" && curl -s http://localhost:3100/blog/1 | grep -o "<title>[^<]*</title>" | head -1 && curl -s http://localhost:3100/blog/1 | grep -c "sunt aut facere" && echo "--- 404 page" && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3100/nope && curl -s http://localhost:3100/nope | grep -o "404 - Page Not Found" | head -1

echo "--- GET /api/posts" && curl -s -w " [%{http_code}]
" http://localhost:3100/api/posts | head -c 200 && echo "--- POST invalid" && curl -s -w " [%{http_code}]
" -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{}' http://localhost:3100/api/posts && echo "--- POST valid" && curl -s -w " [%{http_code}]
" -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"T","content":"C"}' http://localhost:3100/api/posts && echo "--- PATCH (method not allowed)" && curl -s -o /dev/null -D - -X PATCH http://localhost:3100/api/posts | grep -iE "HTTP|allow" && echo "--- GET /api/posts/7" && curl -s -w " [%{http_code}]
" http://localhost:3100/api/posts/7 && echo "--- PUT /api/posts/7" && curl -s -w " [%{http_code}]
" -X PUT -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"New"}' http://localhost:3100/api/posts/7 && echo "--- DELETE /api/posts/7" && curl -s -w " [%{http_code}]
" -X DELETE http://localhost:3100/api/posts/7 && echo "--- missing post page -> notFound" && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}
" http://localhost:3100/blog/999999

curl -s http://localhost:3100/blog/999999 | grep -o "404 - Page Not Found" | head -2; curl -s http://localhost:3100/blog/999999 | grep -o 'name="robots"[^>]*' | head -1; echo "--- existing post id 11 (not in generateStaticParams, generated on demand)"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3100/blog/11 && curl -s http://localhost:3100/blog/11 | grep -o "<title>[^<]*</title>" | head -1; pkill -f "next start" || pkill -f "next-server" || true
cd /workspace && git status --short && echo --- && find app components -type f | sort && echo --- && ls next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null || echo "no next-env.d.ts (Next generates types in .next/types)"
cd /workspace && git diff package.json tsconfig.json | head -40
